LanguageData.HeavyAnimalArmorHuge.label: heavy animal armor (huge)
LanguageData.HeavyAnimalArmorHuge.description:
Heavy-duty animal armor. Cumbersome, but offers a significant amount of protection due to thick plasteel plating and a high-quality synthread lining.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 2.4 or greater.
